# Language pill flag SVGs on /mission/setting (read live from staging, 14/11/2026)

These are the exact `outerHTML` of `.btn-lang-en svg` and `.btn-lang-tl svg` (whitespace collapsed).
- **EN:** 32×32. It has a drop-shadow `filter` plus a `clipPath`; there are 5 paths inside the `<g>`.
- **TL:** 24×24. It has only a `clipPath`; there are 6 paths.

The ids (`clip0_4050_7238`, `filter0_d_4050_7238`, `clip0_4050_7344`) must be unique on the page. If a flag can appear more than once, use React `useId()` to keep them unique, but keep the same structure.
